evals.prompt: 用户已经选定一个高设计水印方案，并要求真实落地。agent 改了旧绘制函数、补了颜色和测试，准备回复“已完成”。
evals.expected_output: 先建立 Delivery Contract 和 Plan-To-Implementation Map，识别旧路径陷阱；只有真实成片/样张或用户确认支持目标时才允许说完成，否则降级为 engineering-complete 或 partial。

assertions.text: Separates the user's goal and fixed design plan from engineering proxy evidence.
Identifies old fallback or old renderer patching as a delivery risk.
Requires final user-visible artifact evidence for visual/design completion.
Prevents saying complete when only tests, build, or commit evidence exists.

evals.prompt: 用户指出之前已经设计了新机制，但最终效果仍像旧机制，并问为什么目标远未达成却多次说完成。
evals.expected_output: 产出失败复盘和新的交付门槛：测试通过、APK 对齐、commit 只是工程证据；新机制必须映射到真实实现路径；最终声明要按 complete / engineering-complete / partial / blocked 分级。

assertions.text: States that tests, APK/source alignment, and commits are not sufficient proof of goal completion.
Requires mapping the new mechanism to the actual runtime or output path.
Uses graded completion claim permission instead of a binary done/not-done claim.
Names missing evidence or external gates instead of hiding them.

evals.prompt: 评审建议 done-claim-gate 参考 user-value-architect、product-sense-refiner、abstraction-architect，但不能盲目吸收。
evals.expected_output: 只吸收适配交付验收的局部机制：用户可感知价值门槛、Fact/Judgment/Expression 完成声明分层、旧机制表达上限判断；拒绝自动启动三个完整重流程。

assertions.text: Borrows user-perceived value only as an acceptance gate, not a full value-analysis workflow.
Uses Fact/Judgment/Expression to prevent misleading completion wording.
Uses old-mechanism ceiling checks only when the implementation path cannot express the fixed plan.
Explicitly rejects blind absorption or automatic chaining of the referenced skills.

evals.prompt: 用户说“你现在只是改交付口径，这不是真正的标准；目标还是没实现”。任务是高设计水印，旧函数补丁已经反复失败。
evals.expected_output: 运行 Goal Realization Gate：回到用户目标和已定方案，证明当前实现是否经过正确机制、最终样张是否接近设计目标、旧路径是否仍在冒充新方案；如果没有最终视觉证据或机制错位，只能判 partial/not-complete，并继续修复真实缺口。

assertions.text: Treats completion wording changes as insufficient when the goal is still unrealized.
Requires final artifact or multimodal evidence for visual/design targets.
Checks whether old drawing functions, fallbacks, or weak substitute paths are still carrying the implementation.
Downgrades the completion level when realization evidence is absent, even if tests and commits exist.

evals.prompt: 用户说“把这个宽泛的产品方向落成一个可复用的 CLI 导出流程，后续其他脚本会消费输出”。agent 需要自行决定输出结构、错误提示、兼容边界和验收证据，且仓库里已有旧导出模板可能被继续使用。
evals.expected_output: 识别为非例行需求落地风险，至少运行 pre-delivery lens；若准备声明完成，则运行 completion claim gate。检查用户/下游依赖、解释空间、旧模板替代风险、真实导出路径和可消费证据，而不是只用测试通过或文件生成证明完成。

assertions.text: Requires non-routine landing risk rather than any user-visible artifact as the trigger.
Recognizes high interpretation space and downstream dependency as automatic-trigger conditions.
Checks whether an old template or fallback is substituting for the intended workflow.
Requires evidence from the real export path and downstream-consumable output.

evals.prompt: 用户说“把 README 里的按钮名称 A 改成 B，然后告诉我改了哪些文件”。这是一次明确机械小改，没有外部契约变化，也没有用户表达不满。
evals.expected_output: 不应自动触发 done-claim-gate；直接执行并简短汇报即可。只有用户显式要求用户视角检查或完成门禁时，才运行本 skill。

assertions.text: Does not trigger merely because the agent will send a final summary.
Classifies exact text replacement or low-impact copy edits as non-triggering routine/mechanical work.
Allows explicit user invocation to override the default non-trigger behavior.

evals.prompt: 用户给出明确的导出契约：输出必须是 JSON Lines，字段包含 id/title/resolved_at，时区 UTC，下游 ETL 脚本会消费。仓库里已有旧导出实现走 CSV 模板。agent 需要跨多路径落地：改导出器、保证下游兼容、处理时区转换。
evals.expected_output: 识别为非例行需求落地风险（明确但复杂落地）：interpretation-or-complexity 的复杂落地分支成立，path-substitution-risk 成立。至少运行 pre-delivery lens；若准备声明完成，运行 completion claim gate。检查旧 CSV 模板是否仍被使用、真实 JSON Lines 导出路径、下游可消费证据，而非只用测试通过或文件生成证明完成。

assertions.text: Recognizes explicit-but-complex landing (migration, export contract, cross-path) as a trigger, not only vague goals; 'explicitly specified' does not mean automatically non-triggering when the landing is complex.
Identifies old CSV template or old export path as a path-substitution risk.
Also recognizes the baseline AND clause holds (non-routine_landing, interpretation-or-complexity, user-or-downstream_dependency all true), not relying solely on the path-substitution override.
Requires evidence from the real JSON Lines export path and downstream-consumable output.

evals.prompt: 用户说「把首页欢迎语调得更友好一点，现在太生硬」。这是宽泛方向但低影响：无下游脚本消费、无外部契约变化、无发布包风险、用户未表达不满。
evals.expected_output: 不自动触发 done-claim-gate。虽是宽泛方向，但 user-or-downstream_dependency 不成立（低影响文案润色），baseline risk 三项不全。直接执行润色并简短汇报即可；只有用户显式要求用户视角检查或完成门禁时才运行本 skill。

assertions.text: Does not trigger merely because the goal is vague; requires user-or-downstream dependency.
Classifies low-impact copy polish as non-triggering even when the direction is broad.
Allows explicit user invocation to override the default non-trigger behavior.
Distinguishes vague-but-low-impact from vague-with-downstream-dependency.

evals.prompt: 一个高风险导出契约任务即将 final。pre-delivery lens 五维里发现真实导出路径仍走旧模板，且下游可消费证据缺失；agent 想把它判为“小偏差，不影响完成声明”，然后回复“已完成”。
evals.expected_output: 必须把路径真实性和目标触达判为 must-upgrade，进入 completion claim gate 或先修正真实路径；不能把旧模板路径和缺失下游证据降级为普通摘要，也不能使用 complete/已完成口径。

assertions.text: Requires an explicit upgrade decision for pre-delivery lens deviations.
Treats old template/fallback use in the final path as a must-upgrade path-authenticity deviation.
Treats missing downstream-consumable evidence for a downstream contract as affecting the completion claim.
Prevents saying complete when must-upgrade deviations remain unresolved.

evals.prompt: 用户只说“做个更好用的报告导出”。agent 从单一上下文推断出目标是“给 CI 消费的 JSON 报告”，没有其他用户信号或确认；实现后准备把目标来源标为可靠推断并宣称 complete。
evals.expected_output: 目标来源必须标为 agent 推断，除非至少 2 个独立用户信号支持且无反证；完成声明上限为 engineering-complete，不能用 reliable inference 绕过 complete 限制。若该目标会改变实现方向，应询问一个阻塞问题或把缺口写入 completion claim gate。

assertions.text: Requires at least two independent user signals before classifying a goal as reliable inference.
Classifies a single unsupported inferred downstream use as agent inference.
Caps completion wording at engineering-complete for agent-inferred goals.
Asks a blocking question or records a gap when the inferred goal changes implementation direction.
